verdict.rationale: Incident management with on-call schedules and escalation policies is a fair question for an observability platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows Triggers and SLO alerts that route notifications to PagerDuty, OpsGenie or incident.io, plus deployment markers. Those are adjacent alerting features and third-party integrations, not native incident declaration, timelines, on-call scheduling or escalation.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can declare and track incidents with timelines, on-call schedules, and escalation policies
